スケジューリング: Single-machine sequencing: enumerate permutations (or DP over subsets) and score total tardiness or completion from a running clock. Identical or unrelated parallel machines: CP-SAT with one boolean per (job, machine), a load per machine, minimise the maximum load. Permutation flow shop: enumerate job orders and simulate stage-by-stage completion times. Critical path: topological order, forward pass for earliest start, backward pass for latest start, zero-slack activities form the critical path. Rosters, timetables and capacity-limited assignments: CP-SAT booleans with one constraint per requirement. Report makespan as the largest completion time of your own schedule.
配送・輸送: Routes start and end at the depot id. Every customer appears exactly once across routes, each route's demand stays within vehicle capacity, and you may use at most the given number of vehicles. With about ten customers, solve exactly: dynamic programming over customer subsets (best tour per feasible subset, then partition the subsets into routes) or CP-SAT with AddMultipleCircuit and load variables. Distances are Euclidean from the coordinates; sum them leg by leg without rounding and report that sum as the total.
ネットワークフロー: Use networkx exact algorithms: maximum_flow_value, min_cost_flow (set node demand negative at sources), shortest_path_length / single_source_dijkstra, minimum_spanning_tree, and bipartite matching (hopcroft_karp_matching). Decide from the text whether edges are directed or undirected before building the graph. When only a value is required, return the algorithm's value; when a path or tree is required, return the node ids as given.
施設配置・被覆: Set cover, set partition, vertex cover, maximum coverage, p-median, p-center and facility location are all small CP-SAT models: one boolean per candidate site (and per assignment where customers are assigned), coverage or assignment constraints, then minimise cost or maximise covered demand. Test coverage with the Euclidean distance between the given coordinates and the radius. Total cost is the sum of opening costs plus assignment or transport costs of your own choice of sites.
ナップサック・パッキング: 0/1, bounded, multi-dimensional and multiple knapsacks: CP-SAT with integer or boolean quantities, or DP when there is a single small capacity. Bin packing: CP-SAT with item-to-bin booleans and used-bin booleans, minimise used bins, and number the bins from 0 in the returned mapping. Strip packing: CP-SAT with fixed-size intervals in x and y plus AddNoOverlap2D, minimise the height. Return the chosen item ids or indices exactly as the schema shows and recompute the value from those items.
割当・マッチング: One-to-one assignment: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment. Generalised assignment with capacities, and bottleneck (min-max) assignment: CP-SAT (for min-max, minimise a variable bounded below by every chosen cost). Quadratic assignment with five or six facilities: enumerate permutations and evaluate sum(flow[i][j] * distance[p[i]][p[j]]). Stable matching: Gale-Shapley. Return the assignment as the schema shows (usually a dict keyed by agent id) and recompute the cost or profit from it.
生産・在庫計画: Product mix, blending and multi-period production are LPs: scipy.optimize.linprog with method='highs'; keep the continuous quantities as returned by the solver and compute the objective from them. Lot sizing with setup costs: dynamic programming over periods (Wagner-Whitin) or CP-SAT with setup booleans. Workforce planning with hire and fire costs: CP-SAT over integer headcounts per period. Newsvendor with a discrete demand distribution: evaluate the expected profit for every candidate order quantity and pick the best.
金融・投資: Capital budgeting: CP-SAT knapsack over projects. Cash-flow matching: LP over bond holdings with a per-period cash balance that carries surplus forward. Mean-absolute-deviation portfolio: LP with weights that sum to 1, no shorting, an expected-return floor, and one auxiliary variable per scenario bounding the absolute deviation. Report the objective computed from your own weights or holdings.
複合・グラフ最適化: TSP on a distance matrix: CP-SAT AddCircuit over arc booleans, return the tour starting from city 0. Graph colouring, maximum clique and maximum-weight independent set: CP-SAT booleans with one constraint per edge. Unrelated parallel machines: CP-SAT with job-to-machine booleans and a makespan bound. Unit commitment, production-distribution and multi-stage supply chains: CP-SAT or LP over the given periods and arcs, then recompute the total cost from the plan you return.
